summary: Focused test of Sign-In Health Check. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass (POST /api/auth-events accepts all 5 kinds, dedups per session+kind, returns 422 for bad kind/session_id/host/missing fields; GET /api/admin/signin-health returns 401 without a token, 403 for a member, and 200 for an admin with days=7/14/30; checked series length, today's date, failed=me_failed+bounced, host counts, the today_fail_rate formula, and 422 for days=0/91). Frontend: /sign-in sends signin_page; a ticket sign-in sends signed_in once per session and not again on reload; the admin dashboard shows admin-signin-health with signin-today, signin-chart and signin-hosts; the 7/14/30 switch refetches (7 and 10 x-ticks); growth and journey still render. Regression: sign-in page, Discover after sign-in, chat list and DealRoom (chat-receipt shows 'Sent' check icon) all OK. Found 1 logic bug: deliberate logout is counted as 'bounced'.

minor.issue: Public and unauthenticated, with no rate limit. Anyone can post unlimited random session_ids and inflate the failure metrics or flip the red alert.

Two identical requests sent at the same moment can make update_one(upsert) hit the unique (session_id, kind) index and raise DuplicateKeyError, which returns a 500. Catch DuplicateKeyError and return ok.
Days and 'today' use UTC boundaries, while the admins are in IST. Between 00:00 and 05:30 IST, today's fail rate covers yesterday's IST evening.

integration_issues.issue: False positive, reproduced: sign in, then click Settings > Log out (profile-logout-button) within 3 minutes. The app sends kind='bounced' in the same session that already sent 'signed_in'. hmf_auth_attempt is never cleared after a successful sign-in, so every normal logout (and the 6s blocked auto-signout) shortly after login counts as a sign-in loop and inflates 'failed'.
Shell is shared by SignIn and SignUp, so visits to /sign-up are also recorded as signin_page. Probably fine, but the 'Login page' column also counts sign-ups.
The 30s /me poll can send me_failed after signed_in in the same session (one transient error), so that session counts as both a success and a failure.

design_issues.screen: Admin dashboard > Sign-in health > By web address
issues: Long hosts are cut off (e.g. 'brandface--8c51lg3n.p...') with no title tooltip. Add title={x.host}.

action_items: In MeContext, on successful /me, also call sessionStorage.removeItem('hmf_auth_attempt'). Optionally skip 'bounced' when hmf_auth_signed_in is already set. This stops logouts being counted as sign-in loops.
Catch DuplicateKeyError in auth_event so concurrent duplicate posts cannot return a 500.
Consider basic rate limiting or abuse protection on the public /api/auth-events endpoint.
Optional: compute days in IST (Asia/Kolkata) for the admin view; add a title tooltip on truncated host cells.
critical_code_review_comments: SignedOut calls authEvent during render, which is a side effect in render. Harmless because it is deduped, but better in a useEffect.
admin_signin_health filters with a string comparison of ISO timestamps. That works only because every 'at' value is UTC isoformat with the same offset, so keep iso() consistent.
seed_data_creation: Temporary: iter4 profiles for brand/creator test users, one chat deal plus message, and auth_events/events from 4 browser sessions and the pytest sessions. All deleted by id/session_id, including TEST_hc1. The auth_events collection is empty afterwards. ui_setup_iter4.py clean was run.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin/brand/creator +clerk_test users via sign-in tickets). Unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter5_signin_health.py -n 0 (it cleans its own sessions and TEST_hc1). For UI: python tests/ui_setup_iter4.py (profiles plus tickets), then optionally python tests/ui_setup_iter5.py (chat deal plus fresh admin/brand tickets). Open tickets at /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<t>. Read hmf_sid from sessionStorage to get the browser session ids, then delete those auth_events/events afterwards. Sign-in via ticket sometimes skips the signin_page event because Clerk redirects before Shell mounts. To verify the bounce fix: log in, then within 3 minutes click profile-logout-button and check that no 'bounced' event is posted.
